tool.name: end_call_recording_declined
tool.description: Ends the call for a caller who has said they do not want this call recorded. Call it at once, in a turn with no speech of your own: the phone system itself then tells them that recording cannot be switched off on this line, that the call ends now and that the owner will call them back at this number, and says goodbye. It is not for a caller who only asks about the recording (whether it is on, or whether it can be switched off), wants one detail kept off the recording, wants to speak to a person, or takes the objection back.

messages.text: Recording can't be switched off on this line, so I'll end the call now. The owner will call you back at this number. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
